_note: EP2 -> NoöPunk conversion matrix (issue #60, work package B). Canonical machine-readable record of which Eclipse Phase 2E subsystem NoöPunk currently inherits, modifies, replaces or defers -- and, per subsystem, whether code exists. This file RECORDS status; it does not decide canon. Every 'implemented' verdict was measured by inspecting src/ on 2026-10-03, not asserted. Where a question is the author's to settle, the row says so and stays unsettled.
_source_of_truth: Issue #60 is canon. RULEBOOK.md is the living rules ledger; where this file and the rulebook disagree, the rulebook wins and this file is stale.
_labels: Status values are RULEBOOK.md section 3's five provenance labels, verbatim: EP2 BASELINE / MODIFIED EP2 / NOÖPUNK NATIVE / EXPERIMENTAL / DEFERRED. 'NOT YET MAPPED' is used where the EP2 source has not been read and guessing would be fabrication.
_measurement: 'implemented' is a code verdict (grep of src/), not a design verdict. A subsystem can be implemented and still DEFERRED as design (e.g. psionics), or specified and not implemented.

ep2_rules_reference._note: Authoritative EP2 rules locations. The online rules site serves the full English text; these chapter paths were read from the site's own navigation on 2026-10-03, not recalled.
ep2_rules_reference.licence_status: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the online rules and Quick-Start (audited in docs/sources/EXTERNAL_SOURCE_LICENSES.md)

chapters.06: How It Came To Be (setting history)

status_values.meaning: Inherited from EP2 with no important intended mechanical change.
Derived from EP2 but simplified, renamed, rescaled, combined or otherwise changed.
Designed for NoöPunk, not intended to reproduce an EP2 mechanic.
Being tested and may be discarded.
The EP2 source has not been read; recording a status would be fabrication.

subsystems.name: Action resolution (d100 roll-under tests)
subsystems.conversion_note: Percentile roll-under with a target number. No intended mechanical change.
subsystems.rationale: RULEBOOK section 10 is marked EP2 BASELINE. The kernel implements roll-under directly.

subsystems.name: Superior results (33/66 rule)
subsystems.conversion_note: The mechanic is inherited; the naming may eventually be re-skinned.
subsystems.rationale: EP2 'How to Play' states the 33/66 rule; the kernel implements the two-tier superior bands.

subsystems.name: Critical doubles (incl. 00/99 absolutes)
subsystems.conversion_note: Doubles are criticals; 00 and 99 behave as absolutes.
subsystems.rationale: EP2 source states doubles are critical successes/failures with 00/99 absolutes.

subsystems.name: Defaulting (to aptitude, or to a related skill)
subsystems.conversion_note: No modifier for defaulting; critical successes are ignored. Related-skill defaulting carries a negative modifier.
subsystems.rationale: EP2 states defaulting has no modifier but ignores critical successes.

subsystems.name: Modifier cap (+/-60)
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch03 Game Mechanics: how-to-play (Difficulty and Modifiers)
subsystems.conversion_note: EP2 states no set of multiple modifiers should impact a test by more than +/-60.
subsystems.rationale: Direct match to the EP2 rule text.

subsystems.name: Pools (Insight / Moxie / Vigor / Flex)
subsystems.conversion_note: Four pool categories with maximum/current state and recharge. Declared EP2 BASELINE / EXPERIMENTAL FOR CONCORDIA.
subsystems.rationale: RULEBOOK section 11 status line; the kernel implements spend and recharge.

subsystems.name: Common pool test manipulations
code: src/eclipse_phase_homebrew/core.py (PoolSpend: ADD_20, IGNORE_MODIFIERS, FLIP_FLOP, UPGRADE_SUCCESS, DOWNGRADE_CRITICAL_FAILURE)
subsystems.conversion_note: +20, ignore modifiers, flip-flop, upgrade success, downgrade critical failure.
subsystems.rationale: The five manipulations named in docs/sources/EP2_HOME_BREW_SOURCES.md are implemented.

subsystems.name: Opposed tests
subsystems.conversion_note: Implemented with an explicit result ranking.
subsystems.rationale: Implemented and exercised by the playable slice and the #74 scenario.

subsystems.name: Combat
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 13 declares it 'intentionally minimal'. A single attack resolution, not the full EP2 combat sequence (ranged/melee/beam/spray/thrown weapon distinctions are not implemented).
subsystems.rationale: One attack function exists; EP2 ch12 has 30 sections of combat detail, so most of it is deliberately not ported.
not_implemented: weapon categories (beam / spray / thrown / kinetic / seeker)

subsystems.name: Physical harm, wounds and stress
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch12 Action and Combat: physical-health, mental-health, disorders
subsystems.conversion_note: Harm state with wound threshold. EP2's full damage-track, healing, repair and psychosurgery procedures are not implemented.
subsystems.rationale: Harm state exists and survives a save/load round trip; the detailed tracks are deliberately absent.

subsystems.name: Social interaction
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 17 declares 'EP2 BASELINE + NOÖPUNK SIMULATION EXPANSION'. The NoöPunk social-simulation layer (section 21) is the intended expansion and is NOT implemented.
subsystems.rationale: A social action resolves; the social-science simulation layer is separate and native.

subsystems.name: Mesh / hacking
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch13 The Mesh: mesh-actions, authentication-and-encryption, devices-apps-and-links
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 15 declares it 'a major NoöPunk reskin/replacement target'. One hack action resolves; EP2's mesh topology, encryption, apps/links and mesh-insert stack are not ported.
subsystems.rationale: Status is the rulebook's own; only a single action exists in code.

subsystems.name: Embodiment / morphs
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch04 Making Characters: morphs; ch15 Transhuman Tech: resleeving, acquiring morphs
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 14 calls this 'a core NoöPunk subsystem'. Embodiment is represented compactly; resleeving, forking/merging, backups and morphology catalogs are not implemented.
subsystems.rationale: A compact embodiment object exists; the EP2 catalogs are deliberately not imported.

subsystems.name: Gear and inventory
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch16 Gear: gear-rules, acquiring-gear, nanofabrication, common-tech-and-ware
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 18: 'EP2 BASELINE DATA, selectively imported'. Inventory mechanics exist; the gear catalogue is not imported and no economy is defined.
subsystems.rationale: Stack-safe add/remove exists; no item catalogue and no economy.

subsystems.name: Character representation (sheet, aptitudes, skills)
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch04 Making Characters: character-stats, skills, active-skill-list
subsystems.conversion_note: A character carries name, aptitudes, skills, pools, harm and embodiment. EP2's character-creation pipeline (13 steps, templates, gear packs, traits) is NOT implemented.
subsystems.rationale: RULEBOOK section 9 is 'EP2 BASELINE -> expected heavy NoöPunk conversion'. The sheet is EP2-shaped; creation is absent.

subsystems.name: Character creation
subsystems.conversion_note: Not implemented, and #60 does not require it for the first playable milestone. Recorded as DEFERRED rather than guessed.
subsystems.rationale: Measured: no creation code exists in src/. The playable scenarios hand-author their actors.

subsystems.name: The skill list
subsystems.conversion_note: No closed skill list is enforced anywhere; checks name a skill and the kernel resolves it. EP2's Active Skill List and Know Skills are not transcribed.
subsystems.rationale: Deliberate: transcribing EP2's skill list would import a large catalogue the project has not adopted.

subsystems.name: Reputation networks
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 17 names it, but no reputation mechanic is implemented. No numeric reputation is defined.
subsystems.rationale: Measured: only fixture text mentions reputation; no mechanic exists.

subsystems.name: Psi / psionics
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch14 Psi: psi-overview, watts-macleod-sub-strains, psi-sleight-summaries, influence-effects
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 16 marks it EP2 BASELINE FOR PROTOTYPE with NoöPunk replacement expected. Both #74 and the rulebook state psionics stay MECHANICALLY DEFERRED: setting lore is not a licence to invent a psi subsystem.
subsystems.rationale: EP2 source is available (ch14), but implementing it would pre-empt an author decision on a subsystem the project explicitly expects to replace.

subsystems.name: AI, AGI, infomorphs and non-human agents
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch13 The Mesh: ais-and-muses, infomorphs; ch02 Starting Out: core-concepts
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 19: 'MODIFIED EP2 / NOÖPUNK NATIVE DIRECTION'. LLM-capable and scripted NPCs coexist; the LLM provider sits behind a replaceable adapter.
subsystems.rationale: Implemented and demonstrated: the #74 scenario runs with a scripted NPC and an optional LLM actor.

subsystems.name: Important vs background NPCs
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 20: 'NOÖPUNK NATIVE ARCHITECTURE'. Deliberately not an EP2 conversion; EP2 has no equivalent tiering.
subsystems.rationale: The coexistence of dumb and LLM agents is a NoöPunk design decision, verified working in #74.

subsystems.name: Social-science simulation layer
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 21 declares it NOÖPUNK NATIVE and explicitly says the RPG rules must not be made responsible for it. Specified as direction; not implemented.
subsystems.rationale: Out of EP2's scope entirely; flagged so the matrix does not imply EP2 covers it.

subsystems.name: Structured actions for Concordia
subsystems.conversion_note: The intent -> structured action -> deterministic resolution -> observation seam. NOÖPUNK NATIVE architecture wrapping EP2 mechanics.
subsystems.rationale: Implemented and used by the playable slices.

subsystems.name: Persistence and reproducibility
subsystems.conversion_note: Event log, save/load, seeded determinism. Native architecture; EP2 is a tabletop game and has no analogue.
subsystems.rationale: Implemented; round trips are covered by tests.

subsystems.name: Rules adapter contract
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 25: 'NOÖPUNK NATIVE ARCHITECTURE'. Concordia talks to an abstract interface, so the engine can move EP2 -> simplified -> mixed -> native without rewriting the simulation.
subsystems.rationale: This is the mechanism that makes the rest of this matrix safe to act on incrementally.

subsystems.name: Economy
subsystems.ep2_reference: ch09 The New Political Economy; ch16 Gear: acquiring-gear
subsystems.conversion_note: No economy, currency or price model is implemented or defined. Deliberately deferred in #60's reserved list.
subsystems.rationale: Measured: no economy code. Not in scope for the first playable milestone.

subsystems.name: Vehicles
subsystems.conversion_note: Deliberately deferred; #60's reserved list names vehicles.
subsystems.rationale: Measured: no vehicle code.

subsystems.name: Advancement / XP
subsystems.conversion_note: Deliberately deferred in #60's reserved list.
subsystems.rationale: Measured: only an unrelated comment token matches.

subsystems.name: Setting factions
subsystems.conversion_note: NoöPunk uses its own pre-Fall alternate setting. EP2's canon factions and gazetteer are NOT imported; only concepts are preserved where useful, per RULEBOOK section 33.
subsystems.rationale: RULEBOOK section 33 is the canonical world lore and is NoöPunk's own; the matrix must not imply EP2 factions are in use.

subsystems.name: Lighter rules alternatives (Fate / PbtA), with proprietary comparisons kept separate (Neon City Overdrive)
subsystems.conversion_note: RULEBOOK section 24: 'EXPERIMENTAL REFERENCES'. Escape hatches if a subsystem proves too heavy for Concordia. Not imported; the licence audit records that the PbtA conversion could not be verified and the three attached conversions are not present on disk.
subsystems.rationale: Recorded so a later agent does not mistake these for available sources.

unresolved_questions.question: Is the issue #51 four-system unified tag model (Physical / Social / Psychic / Cybernetic, attributes as typed tags) still the CHARACTER canon alongside the EP2 mechanical chassis, or has it been retired in favour of an EP2-shaped character layer?
unresolved_questions.evidence: AGENTS.md section 4 still states the four-system tag model is the canonical character direction. AGENTS.md section 13.9 and section 15 were rewritten by issue #60/#63 to make EP2 the mechanical chassis. RULEBOOK.md section 9 declares character identity EP2 BASELINE with an expected heavy NoöPunk conversion. The superseded four-system text also survives in docs/archive/RULEBOOK.md and docs/archive/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md.
unresolved_questions.why_unresolved: Two binding documents currently say different things, and both were written by the author at different times. Picking one is an author decision; the matrix records the disagreement rather than resolving it (issue #60 is canon, but it does not state which layer wins for characters).

unresolved_questions.question: How much of EP2's depth is wanted in the end state: which of the deliberately unported subsystems (full combat weapon classes, armor, damage tracks, mesh topology, morph catalogues, reputation networks) should eventually be ported, simplified, or dropped?
unresolved_questions.evidence: This matrix lists them under each row's not_implemented. RULEBOOK section 8 says everything beyond the smallest playable kernel may remain deferred until play shows it is needed.
unresolved_questions.why_unresolved: RULEBOOK section 8 already states the policy (defer until play demonstrates a need), so this is answered procedurally rather than by fiat -- but the depth of any given subsystem is still an author call when play reaches it.
